key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr offered the best overall wear–corrosion performance, while HVOF achieved the highest hardness.
engineering_relevance: Selecting HVAF can improve protection of 304 stainless steel components exposed to combined sliding wear and corrosion.
method: Deposit WC-10Co-4Cr on 304 stainless steel using APS, detonation spraying, HVOF and HVAF.
Compare microstructure, Vickers hardness, sliding wear and friction.
Evaluate corrosion potential, current density and resistance.
evidence_signal: HVAF achieved a wear rate of (1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m), versus (36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ for bare steel, and ranked highest in corrosion resistance among the coatings.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify wear-test conditions or corrosion medium, limiting direct transfer to service environments.
paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
